title: Hello World
subtitle: Localization is ready with English and Arabic.

layout.footerDescription: A localized learning platform with Arabic and English support, theme switching, and a shared layout system.
layout.preferencesDescription: Language and theme toggles live in the header so they stay consistent across the whole site.

auth.verifyEmailRequired: Please verify your email address first.
auth.accountLocked: Your account is locked until {{time}} due to multiple failed login attempts.
auth.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Please try again later.

login.title: Login
login.subtitle: Sign in to continue in the {{language}} locale.
login.helper: Use your verified account credentials to access your dashboard and continue your learning path.
login.identifierPlaceholder: Enter your email or unique username

signup.title: Sign up
signup.subtitle: Create a new account for the {{language}} experience.
signup.helper: After signup, the backend sends a verification email and the account moves to the verification step.

verify.title: Verify email
verify.subtitle: Enter the 8-character verification code sent to {{email}}.
verify.helper: The verification code is sent right after signup and confirms your account before dashboard access.
verify.noCode: Didn't get the code? Go back to
verify.resendPrompt: A new verification code can be sent now.
verify.resendSuccess: A new verification code has been sent.
verify.missingEmail: We need the account email to resend the verification code.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we will send a reset link.
forgot.helper: If the email exists, a reset link will be sent immediately.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.subtitle: Create a new secure password for your account.
reset.helper: Use at least 8 characters including uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.
reset.strengthHint: Check the strength meter before confirming your new password.
reset.resendPrompt: A new password reset link can be sent now.
reset.resendSuccess: A new password reset link has been sent.
reset.resendFailed: Couldn't resend the password reset link.
reset.missingEmail: We need the account email to resend the password reset link.
reset.missingEmailHint: Open this reset page from the link in your email so we can resend it.

passwordTools.empty: Generate or enter a password first.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you requested does not exist or has been moved.

password.min: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
password.uppercase: Password must include at least one uppercase letter.
password.lowercase: Password must include at least one lowercase letter.
password.number: Password must include at least one number.
password.symbol: Password must include at least one symbol.

username.min: Username must be at least 3 characters long.
username.max: Username must be at most 24 characters long.
username.pattern: Username can only contain letters, numbers, dots, underscores, and hyphens.

email.domain: Use a supported email domain (gmail.com, outlook.com, hotmail.com, or test.com).

verifyCode.length: Verification code must be 8 characters long.
